patterns.note: Extremely generous whitespace surrounding centered text blocks, creating an airy, almost editorial magazine-like layout.
Section titles consistently use a small, uppercase, letter-spaced serif font, contrasting with a clean, understated sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A minimalist monochrome palette of off-white backgrounds and dark grey text dominates, with no visible accent colors in the main content areas shown.

Upon initial load or slight scroll, a large, centered brand name (BOURII) is present, which then disappears as a more compact, functional sticky navigation bar with the brand logo appears at the top of the viewport.

technique_notes: To achieve the minimalist layout, use large vertical and horizontal padding around content sections, ensuring text blocks are centrally aligned within the available width.

Implement a sticky header that appears after a certain scroll threshold, replacing an initial, larger brand display. This can be done by animating the opacity and position of the header element based on scroll position.
Typography is established by pairing a classic serif for headings and a clean sans-serif for body text, with section titles styled in uppercase with subtle letter-spacing for a refined look.

design_tokens.type_scale: Modest serif headings (~1.5-2x body) with small uppercase labels, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, with significant vertical and horizontal padding around all content elements.

standout: The site's extreme minimalism and vast, intentional whitespace create an almost art gallery or editorial magazine feel, rather than a typical e-commerce site. The subtle, delayed appearance of the functional navigation after an initial brand statement is also distinctive.
